title: Religiöse Friedenswahrung und Friedensstiftung in Europa (1500-1800): Digitale Quellenedition frühneuzeitlicher Religionsfrieden
institution: Herzog August Bibliothek Wolfenbüttel and Universitäts- und Landesbibliothek Darmstadt (edited by Irene Dingel)
region: Holy Roman Empire, France, Bohemia, Poland-Lithuania, Savoy, England
notes: Critical edition of religious peace treaties, edicts and diets, with diplomatic and modernised transcriptions side by side, links to facsimiles at the HAB and notes. The edition covers 1485-1788; 39 source texts (Quellentexte) are dated 1485-1689. The TEI files are served per document at /g/pa000001-00NN (the example data_url is the Speyer Reichsabschied of 1526). Languages include German, French, Latin, Czech, Italian, English, Polish and Dutch. The edition was published in 2020; the site was last modified on 31 July 2022. The counts cover the original-language source texts only, not the German translations or the texts of 1712-1788. Corpus statistics (text and word counts) derived from the Renascor Corpus snapshot v2026.10 (texts harvested from this resource in October 2026, duplicates included; they may cover only part of it).
